description: An overarching autonomous network supervisor agent. It acts as the primary orchestration interface, guiding the user or external systems through structured telecommunications troubleshooting loops (Fault Injection -> Telemetry Triage -> Blast Radius Assessment -> Autonomous Repair -> Synthetic Validation).
tool_description: Use this agent to orchestrate complex end-to-end network triage loops, break down high-level troubleshooting goals, and coordinate specialized agent tasks.
